firstPartyEvidence.finding: Exact recharge prices are set by Z-E-N, may change without notice, and are continuously updated in the mobile app; user must consult the app before each charge.
Current public offer includes contractual pricing and additional volume discounts; app provides Scan & Charge and pricing.
Official app provides network discovery and direct payment; no public tariff endpoint exposed on the store surface.

testedConclusion: No reusable anonymous public/guest station or EVSE -> current direct tariff resolver was recovered from public first-party surfaces or Data Lab artifacts. A third-party 0.66 EUR/kWh observation is not used as direct authority.
reopenCondition: Public/guest Z-E-N app backend, exact Scan&Charge QR tariff payload, or first-party/AFIR/QualiCharge numeric tariff tied to exact Z-E-N EVSE.
